name: Utsumi
source:
A teacher of the Kukuri Gakuen. He is also the former teacher of [url=https://vndb.org/c69557]Ayuki-sensei[/url] and [url=https://vndb.org/c21991]Aya-sensei[/url] from their high school days. He is know as a very strict person and a good advisor.

Most of the students have cold sweats just by hearing his name.
